Subject: Duplicate charges on marketplace invoices / VAT split for Sept

Hi Ava,

We're reconciling our September cloud spend and noticed the attached invoices show the same usage lines billed twice: once on the AWS Marketplace invoice (invoice 12345) and once on the GCP reseller invoice (invoice 98765). Both invoices also list VAT differently — AWS has VAT applied at the account level, GCP shows a country-level VAT split. Our ledger shows we were charged for both and received a small credit, but amounts don't net out.

Can you help confirm:
- Why the same usage appears on both invoices
- Which vendor is ultimately responsible for VAT remittance for those lines
- Timeline for corrected invoices / credit notes (we need this for our month-end close)

Attached: copies of both invoices and a CSV of the marketplace metering export from our tenant.

Thanks,

Hi Julia — thanks for your patience. Quick summary and next steps after internal + partner triage: 

What we found:
- Root cause: CloudReseller's billing flow duplicated a subset of usage so the same meter ids were billed via AWS Marketplace and via their GCP reseller invoice.
- AWS has validated the duplicate transaction ids (Case 1123456789) and will issue a corrected invoice removing the duplicated AWS marketplace lines.
- CloudReseller has agreed to issue a credit for the duplicated amounts for the GCP-reseller invoice.
- VAT: we've asked AWS and CloudReseller to provide jurisdictional VAT remittance statements; preliminary read is that VAT should be remitted by the billed vendor in each jurisdiction — we'll attach the formal docs when available.

What we're sharing now (attached):
- provisional-credit-acme-20261008.pdf — a provisional credit note from Redwood to allow Acme to close books pending partner final credits (provisional, non-posting)
- highlighted metering CSV with the 6 duplicated transaction ids

ETA: AWS initial validation complete; corrected invoice expected in 3–5 business days, partner credit expected within 7 business days. We'll push to shorten where possible.

If this timeline is acceptable, please confirm and we'll keep the urgency on the partner/get AWS to expedite. If you need the provisional credit formatted differently for your AR team, let me know and Laura will adjust.

Thanks,
